text: Two of us from Bangalore going to Goa for 4 days, about 40k total. We love beaches, seafood and nightlife, no temples please, and we hate long bus rides.
Solo history buff, I want to see every fort and old palace in Jaipur. Happy to walk all day, packed schedule is fine.
Family of four with small kids, relaxed pace please, nothing too tiring. Kids like parks and the zoo. Mid-range hotels.
Spiritual retreat in Rishikesh, yoga, ganga aarti, ashrams. Maybe one rafting trip. Avoid crowds if possible.
We're foodies — street food crawls, famous biryani, sweets. Hyderabad, 3 people, around 15000 each.
Premium stay only, I don't care about cost. Art galleries, museums and good restaurants in Mumbai. I hate flying.
Backpacker on a shoestring, hostels, trains only, I love trekking, waterfalls and viewpoints in the hills of Munnar.
Just want to relax: lie on a beach, cafes, a little shopping. Short days out, maybe 5 hours.
Kolkata for the culture — Durga puja vibes, old colonial buildings, book street, sweets. Me and my partner.
Party trip with friends, 6 of us, clubs and bars every night, sleep late, long days out are fine.
